verdict.rationale: Isaac is local software rather than a hosted service, so the self-hosting axis applies. First-party docs show the core components install and run on your own machines: Isaac Sim installs via pip-installable Python packages and has a public GitHub repo. Isaac Lab is open source and runs headless from workstation to data center, and Isaac ROS deploys on workstations or Jetson. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployment, and documented hardware/system requirements and licensing terms for running Isaac Sim itself.
